Summary
: This is the English translation of the Brahma Archana Paddhati which deals with the worship system of Lord Brahma. The author, Pandita Vidyadhara Sukla, was influenced by his observations in Thailand and Southeast Asian countries. The Brahmarchana-paddhati encompasses findings from Indian literature, Vedas, and Puranas, emphasizing Brahma’s high status as the creator deity. The text further outlines Brahma’s roles, attributes, and rituals, and seeks to provide a comprehensive guide to his worship by compiling classical and Vedic mantras, Stotras, and other ritualistic elements. 
Alternative titles: ब्रह्मार्चनपद्धति (Brahmārcanapaddhati), Brahmārcana-paddhati, Brahmarchana Paddhati, Brahmarchanapaddhati, Brahmarcana Paddhati, Brahmarcanapaddhati
